name: Temporally-Grounded Language Generation (TGLG)
description: TGLG is a benchmark for evaluating real-time vision-language models' ability to generate utterances that are semantically accurate and temporally aligned with streaming video input. It measures perceptual updating and contingency awareness in dynamic visual environments.
reputation: A new benchmark with early-stage adoption, mainly of interest to researchers studying real-time multimodal generation and temporal grounding.
notes: Introduces a new metric TRACE for joint semantic and temporal evaluation; datasets from sports broadcasting and egocentric interactions.
